```{r}
library(tidyverse)
```

::: {layout-ncol="2"}
|     | Arithmetic     |
|:---:|----------------|
| \+  | Addition       |
| \-  | Subtraction    |
| \*  | Multiplication |
|  /  | Division       |
| \^  | Exponent       |

|     | Relational               |
|:---:|--------------------------|
| \>  | Greater Than             |
| \>= | Greater Than or Equal to |
| \<  | Less Than                |
| \<= | Less Than or Equal to    |
| ==  | Equal                    |
| !=  | Not Equal                |

:::

## The Assignment Operator <-

This operator creates or edits objects in the R environment tab. These can store any information that R outputs

```{r}
#| error: true
glimpse(my_thing) #I can't see anything because there isn't anything called 'my_thing'
```


```{r}
my_thing <- c(1, 3, 5, 7) #Storing the numbers 1, 3, 5, and 7 in an object called "my_thing"

glimpse(my_thing) #Now, I can see my list of numbers
```
